title: The Puppy Blues Rescue Plan: 30 Days From Overwhelmed to Confident Puppy Mom
short: A calm, practical 30-day plan with printable trackers for the tired, overwhelmed first weeks with a new puppy.
bullets: 30-day plan, week by week, for sleep, potty, biting and routine
4 printable trackers: potty, daily schedule, night and crate log, weekly check-in for you
Why the puppy blues are real, and when to call the vet
shipping: Instant PDF download (16 pages). Nothing is shipped.
imageAlt: Cover of The Puppy Blues Rescue Plan ebook by PuppyGuido
description:
You are not a bad puppy mom

Feeling tired, teary and wondering if you made a mistake is more common than most people admit. The Puppy Blues Rescue Plan is a short, calm guide for the hardest weeks with a new puppy. No guilt and no perfect-dog promises, just small steps you can do on very little sleep.

What is inside (16-page PDF)

  • Why the puppy blues are real, with the research behind them, and what helps
  • The first 72 hours: a gentle setup and rhythm
  • Sleep: crate and night routine
  • Biting: pause, redirect, reward
  • The potty plan
  • A routine that fits real life (work, kids, going solo)
  • Money: planning the first year, with a budget worksheet
  • "Is this normal?" and when to call the vet
  • A 30-day plan, week by week
  • 4 printable trackers

Who it is for

First-time and overwhelmed puppy owners who want a clear next step instead of fifty conflicting opinions.

General education only. It does not replace advice from a veterinarian, a professional trainer or a mental-health professional.
